name: Wetland Replacement Program

funder.name: Government of Alberta (Environment and Protected Areas)

summary: Alberta government programme, funded by wetland replacement fees, that contracts municipalities and non-profits to restore drained wetlands or build new ones in priority watersheds. Participants sign a memorandum of understanding, then a 5-year service contract.
reporting: Participants monitor the new wetland for 4 years, send annual progress reports, and file a final report on wetland establishment after 5 years.

applicant_types.quote: Municipalities and non-profit organizations that are committed to identifying and undertaking wetland replacement projects within priority watersheds are eligible to participate in the Wetland Replacement Program.

geography.quote: Municipalities and non-profit organizations can participate in wetland replacement projects within all municipalities and watersheds across Alberta.

access.quote: For further information or to apply for wetland project funding and partnership opportunities, connect with the Wetland Replacement Program.

reporting.quote: Following construction, program participants monitor the newly established wetland for 4 years. Program participants must submit annual reports to the Wetland Replacement Program outlining project progress and any achievements. After 5 years, program participants are required to submit a final report at the conclusion of their project that reports on the success of wetland establishment.
